audience: cellar, cold-storage and facility teams that read their Sensorist gateways and sensors

useCases.title: Read the latest and extreme values of a gateway
useCases.text: List the gateways and their data sources. Then read the latest values, or the minimum and maximum values with their dates, for one gateway.

useCases.title: Review the alarm history
useCases.text: List the current alarms and their state. Then read the alarm history to see when each alarm went into and out of alarm.

useCases.title: Check the users in the account
useCases.text: Read the user and account details of your login. Add the list option to see every user in the account hierarchy.
